0022600005.text: The Golden State Warriors visit the Los Angeles Lakers in both teams' season openers, with the Warriors playing as the away side in their first game of 2026-27. Golden State is missing Brandin Podziemski (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Collin Sexton (calf). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Warriors lost the series 1-3, including a 119-103 defeat to the Lakers in San Francisco on April 9, 2026.
